source_document.body:
Leading our midweek edition is the Halloween Sale from Jackery with up to $2,060 off discounts on power stations that is running for a few days into November and even has extra savings in the form of an online crossword game. One notable bundle here is the HomePower 2000 Plus v2 2,048Wh Power Station with 2x 200W solar panels at $1,479 , while other deals start from $199. We also have Yozma’s latest IN 11 Electric Dirt Bike that just released getting a FREE $299 gift box and exclusive savings down to a new $1,399 low , as well as Tenways’ Early Black Friday sale that has returned the CGO600 Pro Lightweight Chain-Drive e-bike back to its $1,499 low for the second time this year. There’s also a 40V Greenworks pole saw kit deal, and our hangover deals from yesterday at the bottom of the page, including the Anker SOLIX S5000 power station launch deals with up to $2,150 exclusive savings, as well as the Lectric XP Lite3 folding e-bike launch deals , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Jackery’s Halloween Sale drops HomePower 2000 Plus v2 + 2x 200W solar panels to $1,479 ($360 off), more from $199
Jackery has its Halloween Sale running past the upcoming holiday through November 3 with up to $2,060 savings on power stations, 2x points for members, and even some bonus extra savings on orders over $1,500 won from a crossword game here . One notable option for travelers and emergency preppers alike is the HomePower 2000 Plus v2 2,048Wh Power Station with 2x 200W solar panels down at $1,479 shipped , which matches the price we’re seeing at Amazon . Down from $1,839, discounts on this bundle have mostly kept above $1,659 since the model launched back in June, with the $360 markdown here only beaten out by a dip to $1,430 back during June’s Prime Day event. You can find the standalone station for $1,069 shipped during this sale.
Jackery’s most popular units from the Halloween Sale:
HomePower 3600 Plus (3,584Wh) with 500W solar panel: $2,199 (Reg. $2,729) | matched at Amazon
HomePower 3600 Plus (7,168Wh) with extra battery: $2,599 (Reg. $3,309) | matched at Amazon
HomePower 3600 Plus (7,168Wh) with extra battery and 500W solar panel: $3,199 (Reg. $4,139) | $300 more at Amazon
Explorer 5000 Plus (10,080Wh) with expansion battery: $5,579 (Reg. $6,199) comes with FREE Explorer 300D mini power station
You can browse Jackery’s full Halloween Sale lineup in our original coverage here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Yozma’s latest IN 11 electric dirt bike with wheelie assist gets FREE gift box at exclusive new $1,399 low ($499 savings)
Alongside the ongoing Yozma IN 10 and IN 10 Pro exclusive deals we have running through the rest of the month, the brand is also offering its newest IN 11 Stunt-Ready Off-Road Electric Dirt Bike with a FREE $299 Halloween gift box down at $1,399 shipped , after using our exclusive code 9TO5TOYS100 at checkout. It just hit the market last week at $1,599, with the initial deal here only giving you the gift box with a $100 discount, but our exclusive code cuts an additional $100 off the tag. All-in-all, you’re getting a combined $499 savings package here, marking a new all-time low price not even a week out of the gate.
You can learn all about the IN 11’s features in our original coverage of this exclusive deal here .
Get up to $907 early Black Friday savings on Tenways e-bikes: 37-pound CGO600 Pro commuter at $1,499 low, more
Tenways has launched its Black Friday Early Access deals on three e-bike models, which come with FREE bundled gear. One notable return is the CGO600 Pro Lightweight Chain-Drive Commuter e-bike with a free $118 bundle of gear at $1,499 shipped , while the belt-drive model is sold out of stock. Down from $1,899, this particular model spent most of the first half of 2026 out of stock before coming back in July. In the time since, sales have been discounting it to $1,599, aside from the Labor Day sale that dropped it to $1,499 for the first time in 2026. That rate is now coming around for the second time this year, giving you $400 savings ($518 total) at the all-time lowest price we have tracked. Head below to browse the other deals during this sale.
***Note: This brand offers a non-stackable $150 discount for medical providers, military, first responders, and teachers after verification.
Tenways’ Early Access Black Friday offers:
CGO600 Pro Chain-Drive Commuter e-bike (all-time low): $1,499 (Reg. $1,899) comes with FREE mudguards and kickstand ($118 value) 20 MPH for up to 53 miles
Wayfarer Cruiser e-bike: $1,699 (Reg. $2,199) comes with FREE mudguards, kickstand, rear carrier ($277 value) 20/28 MPH for up to 85 miles
AGO X All-Terrain Mid-Drive e-bike (all-time low): $1,899 (Reg. $2,499) comes with FREE mudguards, kickstand, and rear carrier ($307 value) 20 MPH for up to 62 miles
Make cuts up to 11 feet off the ground with Greenworks’ 40V 8-inch cordless pole saw kit down at $137 (Reg. $180)
Over at Amazon you can currently find the Greenworks 40V 8-inch Cordless Electric Pole Saw with a 2.0Ah battery down at $136.99 shipped , beating out the direct website by $3. Down from $180, this model has mostly been discounted to $144 or $140 in 2026, aside from short-term falls to the $130 annual low during June and October’s Prime Day events. The deal here gives you a solid $43 markdown, landing it at the second-best price of the year – just $7 above that annual low.
